Telephone Manager Message Functions

Clearing Message Handlers

When you no longer need a message handler, you can clear it (that is, deactivate it and free its resources). You also need to clear a message handler before specifying a new set of messages to receive. You can use the functions in this section to clear terminal, directory number, and call appearance message handlers.
